notes.title: NO MAN IS AN ISLAND IS NOW RELEASED!!!
notes.notes:
The game is now officially released. This is the first release, but it has been able to show many features of the game. The videos and pictures in the game store are old. The real game quality has improved greatly, now close to 3A quality. I will update Videos and pictures of the store soon .
The game is released for the first time, there may be some bugs, please tell me in the community, I will keep fast updates and provide support at any time!
